title: Rype's Auto Smithing-Table
description: Upgrade entire inventories of Diamond gear to Netherite automatically from the Smithing Table. Uses Netherite Ingots and Upgrade Templates from your hotbar and includes customizable processing speeds.
body:
# Auto Netherite Smithing

Automatically upgrades Diamond tools and armor to Netherite directly from the Smithing Table with a single button.

## Features

* Adds a Start/Stop button to the Smithing Table GUI.
* Automatically upgrades all supported Diamond tools and armor found in your main inventory (27 inventory slots, excluding the hotbar).
* Uses Netherite Ingots and Netherite Upgrade Templates from any hotbar slot. **MUST BE IN HOTBAR**
* Processes upgrades through normal inventory clicks to mimic standard player interaction.
* Automatically stops when all eligible items have been upgraded.
* Can be manually stopped at any time using the Stop button.
* Automatically stops if the Smithing Table screen is closed.
* Displays action bar warnings when there are not enough Netherite Ingots or Upgrade Templates available.
* Shows exactly how many additional materials are required before the process can start.
* Supports configurable processing speed through Mod Menu, Down to 0.1 ticks.

## Configuration

This mod integrates with Mod Menu and allows you to adjust the delay between smithing operations.

The delay can be increased or decreased in small increments for precise control over processing speed.

## How It Works

1. Place **Netherite Upgrade Templates** and **Netherite Ingots** in your **HOTBAR**.
2. Put **Diamond tools and/or Diamond armor** pieces in your **MAIN INVENTORY**.
3. Open a **Smithing Table**.
4. Press the **Start** button on the top right.
5. The mod will automatically upgrade eligible items one by one until all valid items have been processed.

## Supported Items

### Armor

* Diamond Helmet
* Diamond Chestplate
* Diamond Leggings
* Diamond Boots

### Tools

* Diamond Sword
* Diamond Pickaxe
* Diamond Axe
* Diamond Shovel
* Diamond Hoe

Only Diamond tools and armor are processed. Other items are ignored.

## Notes

* Requires Fabric.
* Requires Mod Menu for configuration access.
* Designed to work through standard inventory interactions rather than instant item modification.
* **Netherite Ingot** and **Upgrade Template** are only read from hotbar slots.
* Items are only processed from the main inventory section and not from the hotbar.
* The mod is client-side and only automates actions that can normally be performed through the Smithing Table interface.

## Disclaimer

Server rules vary. Always ensure that inventory automation mods are permitted on the servers you play on.
